svg.text: Palette — cool grounds, one warm signal
Neutrals carry blue, never a warm cast. The accent is the only warm value, and it appears only where state does.
tint plus a weight shift, so state never rides colour alone
one pill for state; badges share the slot behind a divider
a border means frame, field, or error, never decoration

Rejected #efeae1 ground, ochre and brown accents: warm neutrals and mud read as packaging. Ink on tint: light 13.56:1, dark 5.59:1.
